notes: Slice 05 is entirely the UI/HUD region of halo.exe: interface.c, console/terminal, ui_widget system, shell screens (profiles, map list, settings, multiplayer), then the HUD (messages, chat, scoreboard, nav points, weapon/motion-sensor hud). No library code (no D3DX/CRT/GameSpy/Bink strings). Three seeds labelled 'render' (0x49a2e0 render_ui_cursor, 0x49b450 render_ui_widgets, 0x49d850 render_widget_recursive) sit in the middle of the contiguous ui_widget run and call ui-widget/ui-sound helpers, so they are labelled interface at reduced confidence. Ghidra names 'first_person_weapons_update'/'first_person_weapon_render_update' (0x495190/0x4951f0) are misapplied - the decompiled code is map-name lowercasing/map_check, i.e. part of the map-list file.
